page_title: LEC 2-2 BOL | Lecce v Bologna 28/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Francesco Camarda (Lecce) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.

90+3' 2 - 2 Francesco Camarda (Lecce) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the bottom left corner. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 2:2.
90+3' Medon Berisha (Lecce) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
90+2' Lecce have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
85' Santiago Castro (Bologna) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Francesco Fourneau has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
83' We are about to witness a subsitution. Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) for Emil Holm.
82' The corner kick from Nikola Moro (Bologna) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
77' Tete Morente goes off the pitch and Lameck Banda (Lecce) comes on.
77' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to make a change. Konan Ndri (Lecce) replaces Lassana Coulibaly.
74' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) commits a rough challenge and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for an infringement.
71' 1 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Jens Odgaard (Bologna) gets on the end of a brilliant pass and scores a great goal after finding the back of the net by striking the ball past the goalkeeper!
69' Corrie Ndaba (Lecce) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Antonino Gallo.
68' It is time for a substitution. Jens Odgaard (Bologna) is on for Giovanni Fabbian.
68' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Thijs Dallinga walks off the pitch to be replaced by Santiago Castro (Bologna).
68' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) replacing Jonathan Rowe.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Francesco Camarda (Lecce) comes onto the pitch for Nikola Stulic.
66' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Antonino Gallo (Lecce) receives a yellow card!
66' A great solo run by Antonino Gallo (Lecce) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the bottom right corner was easily caught by Lukasz Skorupski.
63' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) is coming onto the pitch as Riccardo Orsolini cannot continue after picking up an injury.
61' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) has tested the patience of referee Francesco Fourneau and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
61' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the right post. Close!
60' The percentage of ball possession is – 29:71.
55' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francesco Fourneau had an easy-decision to make.
52' Emil Holm (Bologna) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
47' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) makes a strong challenge and Francesco Fourneau blows for a foul.
46' Here comes a substitution. Danilo Veiga (Lecce) is brought on as a substitute for Christ-Owen Kouassi.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Wladimiro Falcone no chance!
45+1' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is going to take the penalty!
45+1' Christ-Owen Kouassi (Lecce) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Francesco Fourneau saw the whole situation. A penalty is given to Bologna!
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' Nikola Moro (Bologna) whips in a cross from the corner, but Wladimiro Falcone is well positioned and punches the ball away.
41' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) sees his long-range effort blocked.

36' A more precise finish was all that was needed for this set play to have been a success. Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) received the ball far out and fired a projectile which went yards wide of the right post.
35' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
31' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
30' Francesco Fourneau shows a yellow card to Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) for his blatant foul.
28' Nikola Moro (Bologna) takes a short corner kick.

28' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Bologna force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
26' Medon Berisha (Lecce) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
25' Medon Berisha (Lecce) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Lecce earn a corner.
24' Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem (Bologna) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post.
23' Nikola Moro (Bologna) prepares to take a corner kick.
22' Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) is penalised for holding. Francesco Fourneau signals a set piece.
20' One of the players from Bologna times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
19' Tete Morente (Lecce) hits the crossbar with a rebound from just outside the box.
15' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
13' 1 - 0 Goal! Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.

13' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Lukasz Skorupski dived superbly to block a header by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the left post, but Lukasz Skorupski pulled off a remarkable save!
12' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Nikola Moro (Bologna) sends it out of play. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.

12' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the bottom right corner, but Wladimiro Falcone pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt. The referee blows his whistle, Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
12' The resulting corner from Nikola Moro (Bologna) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
10' Torbjorn Lysaker Heggem (Bologna) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
8' Bologna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
8' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
7' Juan Miranda (Bologna) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

7' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Bologna force their opponents to concede a corner.
5' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
3' The resulting set piece from Bologna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.

3' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out. Bologna have a corner.
1' The match has just started.
Lecce will kick the game off.
Francesco Fourneau is introduced as the referee for today's match.
